decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on established pharmacy channels and the Trivital brand, costs little to carry, and nothing has emerged that would justify giving up the option.
The skin and hair supplement fits the consumer health expansion strategy, is cheap to maintain, and shows no negative signal, so holding the option remains sensible.
The joint health product extends a familiar brand at low cost, and with no evidence of failure the option is worth keeping.

The valsartan generic survived the 2018 recall and is apparently still marketed, so its value is partly revealed and generic substitution channels keep carrying costs modest, although it remains outside the core offer.
The OTC triptan is a recent launch with a dedicated page in a growing self-medication segment, and its uncertainty is unresolved while carrying costs are low, so the option should stay open.
